source.title: Liberty 2026–2027 Undergraduate Catalog (October22,2026): online residency and transfer policy
source.retrieval: Actual full undergraduate catalog PDF retrieved 2026-11-18; SHA-256 verified. Reviewed online policy in physicalPDF pages30,32,33,41 (printed29,31,32,40).
source.scope: Current2026–2027 online undergraduate associate/bachelor residency policies, with explicit degree-specific exceptions. General provider recognition and duplicate-credit policy do not establish an individual award.
source.notes: Full catalog retains the actual policy text omitted from the current parent-page overview. No separate combined alternative-credit ceiling was found.

policies.majorException: The exact degree or minor requirements may specify a different rule.
policies.alternativeCapStatus: No separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling established by this review.

reviewedStatements.heading: Graduation Requirements
reviewedStatements.summary: Associate and bachelor degrees require one quarter of the degree and major component through Liberty. Major/minor rules yield to explicit degree requirements.

reviewedStatements.heading: Transfer Credit Policy
reviewedStatements.summary: Undergraduate credit uses semester units. Courses without sufficiently similar named equivalents can receive level-coded elective credit; that general policy does not establish a particular award.

reviewedStatements.heading: Institutional Challenge Examinations and other online-course providers
reviewedStatements.summary: The catalog recognizes other online-course providers through ACE guidance and academic review. Recognition alone does not verify course identity, recommendation windows or a program-level match.

doesNotEstablish: Provider course identity or recommendation periods

supersededParentCapture.reviewOutcome: Current HTML is a registrar overview and no longer contains the residency paragraphs visible in the indexed catalog body. This capture proves page identity, not the numeric residency policy.

rawCapture.method: Actual PDF bytes verified by SHA-256 and reviewed with local pdftotext; online graduation requirements printed page40 and transfer residency printed page29.

residencyQuote: 25% of major and 25% of degree must be taken through Liberty University.
duplicateCreditSummary: Credit for the same course can count only once toward a degree, whether earned at Liberty, another institution or through standardized testing.
